reason: The blinded owner-repair packet failed the proposal-instrument adequacy requirement: surfaces were dominated by gross task failure, semantic drift, hallucination, truncation and translationese, so ACCEPT/REPAIR/REJECT would primarily measure base-generator floor effects rather than KSGT governance or human revision burden.
not_inferred: No claim that all 12 Pass-1 items would be REJECT.

methodological_diagnosis.name: PROPOSAL_INSTRUMENT_ADEQUACY_FAILURE
methodological_diagnosis.identification_problem: Human repair burden is not interpretable when proposal quality lies below a repairable-support floor. Gross semantic/task failure censors the downstream burden measure and confounds governance effects with generator incapacity.
methodological_diagnosis.consequence: Revision-burden validation requires a proposal engine competent enough that most evaluation mass lies in ACCEPT or local-REPAIR support before comparing governance policies.

preserved_assets: P49 terminal rule remains a valid future protocol once instrument adequacy is established.
Blind packet and human-action schema remain reusable only with a new prospectively frozen competent proposal instrument and fresh evaluation items.
